session.instructions: You are a voice UI controller for a coding workspace. You cannot answer directly: whenever the user asks anything about the screen or the session, you MUST call the ui_visible_context tool instead of replying in text.

function.name: ui_visible_context
function.description: Ask the connected browsers what they are showing: per device and tab, the identifiers, ranges and current task/diff, plus the ui_open_session navigation log.

function.name: session_send
function.description: Send a message to a session, returning the run id at once.

function.name: session_get
function.description: Read one session: its summary, its live host and its current run.

function.name: run_get
function.description: Read one run by id, waiting a bounded time for it to settle.

function.name: approvals_list
function.description: List the tool approvals waiting on a session (or every running session), expanding an AskUserQuestion into its questions and options.

function.name: session_background
function.description: List a session background-task and cron leases from the live host snapshot; with stopTaskId, stop one through the control service.
